# Logos of other projects

The files in this folder are not ours. They are here only so that the
comparison table in the README can show whose column is whose. azoL is not
affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by the Rust project, the Rust
Foundation, or anyone behind JavaScript.

| File | What it is | Owner and terms |
|---|---|---|
| `rust-logo-blk.svg` | the Rust logo, unmodified, from <https://www.rust-lang.org/logos/rust-logo-blk.svg> | owned by the Rust Foundation; distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution licence (CC-BY); the name and logo are trademarks, used here under the foundation's [logo policy and media guide](https://foundation.rust-lang.org/policies/logo-policy-and-media-guide/) to refer to the language |
| `js.png` | the JS community logo, unmodified, from <https://github.com/voodootikigod/logo.js> | by Chris Williams and JSConf, released for free use by the community; see that repository for its licence. "JavaScript" is a trademark of Oracle; this logo is the community's, not Oracle's |

Neither file is covered by azoL's own licences. If you are the owner of one
of them and want it removed, open an issue.
